title.value: Scottish Deerhound Puppies for Sale in Florida

field_content.value:
As preservation breeders, Hound Ridge occasionally breeds Irish wolfhounds puppy litters and Scottish deerhounds puppy litters. We only breed a bitch once and we only breed hounds that we believe embody the essence of these special breeds. We are passionate about Irish wolfhounds. We are passionate about Scottish deerhounds. Our life revolves around our hounds.

Currently, we have limited availability for several female Scottish deerhounds for sale near Brooksville, Florida. If you are interested in loving a Scottish deerhound puppy, please contact Joyce Weaver about puppy availability. We are dedicated to finding the best homes possible for each of our puppies. We'd like to know more about what your experience and expectations are for your new deerhound family member. When you contact us, please be prepared for questions!
